## Summary

Describe the concrete repository problem and the implemented behaviour.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm pack --dry-run`
- [ ] Tests cover the success and failure paths
- [ ] User-facing changes are documented

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] `doctor` remains read-only
- [ ] No sensitive evidence is copied into findings or errors
- [ ] New fixes are explicit, dry-run-first, and idempotent
- [ ] Fixtures contain no real identities, credentials, private URLs, or personal paths
